headline: SFG @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.16 at MIA 4.57, with a projected total of 8.73. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: SFG moved -0.14 runs while MIA moved +0.45, changing the projected margin by -0.58 runs. The projected total climbed +0.30, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Landen Roupp has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Luis Arraez, Bryce Eldridge, Otto Lopez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Drew Gilbert, Owen Caissie because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
